## Objective
- Build a complete playable 2D stealth game called **SHADOW HEIST** with guards, detection, hiding, distractions, cameras, lasers, multiple routes, five missions, alert meter, atmospheric visuals, and keyboard/mobile controls.

## Requirements
- Guard patrol AI.
- Vision detection system.
- Hiding spots.
- Distraction mechanics.
- Security cameras and laser traps.
- Multiple routes to complete objectives.
- Five missions.
- Alert meter.
- Smooth animations and atmospheric lighting.
- Mobile and keyboard controls.
- Create actual working stealth mechanics and mission objectives.

## Decisions
- Built as dependency-free static HTML/CSS/Canvas 2D project so the default static server can serve it.
- Maps are 40×24 tile facilities generated in `js/levels.js`, with hand-authored walls, patrol routes, lights, points of interest, and security placements.
- Game engine is in `game.js`; level data/theme definitions are in `js/levels.js`.
- All visuals and sounds are procedural Canvas/Web Audio; local Google fonts stored under `assets/fonts/`.
- Game flow is menu → selected mission → in-game intro → play → pause/result dialogs.
- WebAudio is initialized on first user gesture; mute preference saved in `localStorage` under `shadow-heist-muted`.
- Guard AI states: `patrol`, `suspicious`, `investigate`, `search`, `chase`, `return`.
- Global alert reaches 100 → mission failure; guard proximity also fails mission.
- Player movement: WASD/arrows, crouch toggle `C`, sprint `Shift`, interact `E`, throw noise maker `Q`; touch joystick/buttons supported.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `style.css`, `js/levels.js`, `game.js`.
- Implemented menu with five mission cards, dossier panel, briefing modal, help modal, sound toggle, and responsive/mobile layout.
- Implemented 5 level builders and themes, all spawn/objective/exit/patrol paths validated as reachable.
- Implemented player movement, wall collision, crouch/sprint, aim, throwable noise maker, hiding in lockers/cabinets, vent concealment, terminals disabling cameras/lasers, loot pickups, extraction.
- Implemented guard patrol pathfinding, vision cones with wall occlusion, awareness meter, chase/investigation/search, auditory distraction, and catching the player.
- Implemented sweeping cameras, camera confidence/alarm behavior, timed lasers (including low beams requiring crouch), global alert decay/failure.
- Implemented HUD: alert meter, objectives, visibility chip, interact prompts, cooldown indicator, notifications, mission intro.
- Implemented mission success/failure modals, stats, stars, retry/next/menu actions.
- Implemented atmospheric lighting/darkness pass, light bloom cones, wall/floor rendering, hiding props, cameras, lasers, guards, player, particles, screen flashes.
- Added menu background with animated city, rain, searchlights, and embers.
- Basic browser smoke test passed; menu renders and missions start.
- Verified headless-browser screenshots show the game scene, player, guard cones, objective glow, HUD, and lighting.

### Active
